senses.gloss:
वृथा Ind.
 1. Uselessly, fruitlessly.
 2. Wrongly, incorrectly.
 3. In vain,
(in composition with nouns.)
 4. Compounded with articles of food,
it implies they are hot.
 E. वृ to choose, &c., aff. थाक् ।

वृथाकथा f. (-था) Idle talk.
 E. वृथा and कथा speech.

वृथाघात m. (-तः) Striking or killing any being unnecessarily.
 E. वृथा and
आघात a blow.

वृथाट्या f. (-ट्या) Going about or travelling for pleasure.
 E. वृथा and अट्या roaming.

वृथादान n. (-नं) Unprofitable donation, gift to encomiasts, harlots,
wrestlers, money lost at play, &c.
 E. वृथा vain, and दान giving.

वृथापशुघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The slayer of an animal except for sacrifice.
 E. वृथा
and पशु an animal, घ्न who kills.
वृथामांस n. (-सं) Flesh not intended to be offered to the gods or manes.

वृथालम्भ m. (-म्भः) Cutting or plucking unnecessarily.
 E. वृथा and लभि to
get, aff. घञ् ।

वृथोत्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Born or produced in vain.
 E. वृथा and उत्पन्न produced.

वृथसानु m. (-नुः)
 1. A man.
 2. A leaf.
 3. Act, action.
 E. वृध् to increase, असानु aff.
